candidates.name: label_lexicon_snap_memory
candidates.hypothesis: Replacing the ASCII-only tokenizer with character-bigram Dice similarity restores a discriminative retrieval signal on Chinese case facts, and a guarded longest-common-substring snap of each predicted charge unit against the accumulated statute lexicon repairs near-miss statutory names (run >= 4 chars, coverage >= 0.6, unique maximal match) without damaging already-correct short labels, raising exact charge-set accuracy above the 27/100 frontier.

candidates.name: charge_cooccurrence_count_memory
candidates.hypothesis: Treating memory as a weighted charge co-occurrence graph and planning the output cardinality from the structural placeholder-group size in the fact text repairs the dominant under-generation error: labels retrieved from matched cases and support-gated graph companions fill the planned slots, while closed or weakly-attested neighbourhoods stay unchanged, raising exact charge-set accuracy above the 27/100 frontier.
